op: # Scenario summary — DIR=0 (SRAM -> sys mem) with out-of-bounds SRC
#   The descriptor_fetcher bounds check picks the SRAM-side address based on
#   DIR.  For DIR=1 it inspects DST; for DIR=0 it inspects SRC (rtl/
#   descriptor_fetcher.sv:75).  This scenario exercises the DIR=0 selection
#   path so a future regression that mis-wires the mux (e.g. always uses DST)
#   would slip past existing tests but trip this one.
#   DST_ADDR = 0x00000000  (sys mem; ignored by bounds check)
#   unchanged from initial state (no transfer ever reached the data mover).
# desc0: BAD — SRAM-side (SRC) is OOB while DIR=0
